note: Independent audited policy: how a WorldState maps to observable DOM/SVG structure. Deliberately a SEPARATE implementation from the renderer (runtime/observer/render.py). The renderer must never be both the object under test and the answer key (Final Directive v5, principles 1-7, 53, 66).

provenance.reason: Break the Renderer<->Validator shared decision source (layout_geometry). The renderer draws; this contract states what observable structure the draw must exhibit.
provenance.author: phase0-render-projection

ordering.description: Objects ordered by (first-focus time over the whole timeline, id); ties broken by id.

slot.description: Object i (0-based in projection order) occupies an axis-aligned box: x = origin[0] + i*step[0], y = origin[1] + i*step[1], w = box[0], h = box[1].

semantics.identity: Every world-state object must appear as exactly one observable node (data-node id == object id).
semantics.visibility: obj.visible == True must map to a laid-out node that is not hidden, not display:none, with non-zero area and opacity above threshold.
semantics.focus: obj.focus == True must map to a node carrying the focus marker (render data-focus).
semantics.relations: Every Relation must map to an observable edge from source endpoint to target endpoint of the same type.

projection.geometry_contract: observed box geometry must match the slot-derived expected geometry within the calibrated tolerance; deviation is render infidelity, not a semantic failure.
